critical_finding.explanation: The glyph IDs from the name-entry screen (し=126, い=87, あ=86, etc.) are NOT used in dialogue text. Search for adjacent pair (126,87) or (128,87) across all 296 MSG resources returned ZERO matches. The name-entry and dialogue systems use separate glyph ID spaces.
